from collections import Counter

# Obtain token (helper shown; alternatively use apis.spotify.login with supervisor credentials)
access_token = apis.spotify.access_token_from(main_user)

# Fetch all recommendations
all_recs = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page)
    if not batch:
        break
    all_recs.extend(batch)
    page += 1

# Count artist appearances
artist_ids = []
for rec in all_recs:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=rec.song_id)
    artist_ids.extend(a.id for a in song.artists)
counts = Counter(artist_ids)

# Use [-1][0] for least, [0][0] for most
artist_id = counts.most_common()[0][0]
artist_name = apis.spotify.show_artist(artist_id=artist_id).name

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=artist_name, status="success")
